mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `submission` (user_id, question_id, contest_id, language, code_content, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{contestId}, #{language}, #{codeContent}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT question_id FROM `submission` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT * FROM `submission` WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `submission` SET status = 'PENDING', score = NULL, time_used_ms = NULL, memory_used_kb = NULL, error_log = NULL, result_json = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
